content.short: SimpleFX is a free trading and investing app with no fees or minimum deposits, allowing users to trade and stake cryptocurrencies, forex, stocks, and other assets.
content.description: SimpleFX is a free trading and investing app available since 2014, with no fees or minimum deposits. It enables users to trade and stake cryptocurrencies, forex, stocks, and more, and it recently released an iOS mobile app. The platform has earned multiple awards, including Best Trading Platform Cryptocurrency at the Warsaw 2022 World Expo. Creating an account requires only an email address, and deposits and withdrawals are unrestricted. The accompanying blog provides market news, analysis, tutorials, and a trading academy.
